title: Installing Node.js
overview: Node.js is required to run Expo tools and install project dependencies using package managers like npm or yarn.

title: Installing Expo CLI
overview: Expo CLI provides commands to create, run, and manage Expo applications.

title: Creating an Expo Project
overview: Expo provides commands to create a new React Native application with the required configuration.

title: Running Expo Application
overview: Expo development server allows you to run your application on emulator, simulator, or physical device.

title: Running on Physical Device
overview: Expo allows developers to test applications on real devices using Expo Go by scanning a QR code.

example.title: Device Testing
example.content:
Start Expo Server
 ↓
Scan QR Code
 ↓
Open App in Expo Go

title: Expo Project Configuration
overview: Expo projects use configuration files to manage application settings like name, version, icons, and permissions.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned how to install Expo tools, create projects, run applications, test on devices, and configure Expo apps.

example.content:
